schema.description: A basename only; local and repository-relative paths are forbidden.
Canonically sorted before request hashing; every hint remains unverified at registration.
DREQ- followed by the lowercase hexadecimal digest from request_hash.
DREG- followed by the lowercase hexadecimal digest from registration_hash.
RFC 8785 JCS-equivalent UTF-8 SHA-256 over the complete sealed document after schema-declared set sorting and with spec_hash itself excluded.
Stable gate conclusion such as PASS, FAIL, BLOCK, WAIVE, or policy-evidenced NOT_REQUIRED.
Opaque handles only; hidden content must not appear in ordinary artifacts, results, or logs.

Whether executor_ref resolves to a real callable in this release. 'executor_bound' asserts the reference is live and is checked by the executor-resolution gate; 'executor_unbound' declares a specified-but-unbuilt node. Absent means unverified, which the gate reports as a census figure rather than a pass. A workflow whose completeness_contract sets missing_node_policy: FAIL is unsatisfiable while any node it needs is unbound, so this field makes that condition declarable instead of silent.
Phase E is the receipt-bound promotion-pack phase defined by the x-phase-e-promotion-pack annotation.
For phase E, this array materializes every applicable core and conditional promotion-pack kind declared by x-phase-e-promotion-pack; each artifact must have a resolving receipt and VALID status.
RFC 8785 JCS-equivalent UTF-8 SHA-256 over the complete decision with decision_hash itself excluded.
The level newly granted by this decision. PROMOTE and CONDITIONAL require a canonical level; REJECT, UNDERDETERMINED, and BLOCKED require null and do not change the candidate's prior level.
Contains at least candidate_id, candidate_revision, requested_level, promotion_pack_hash, and policy_bundle_hash.
Exact JCS-equivalent canonical query_batch JSON string bound by query_hash.

Page number in the source document, or null when the extraction carries no page geometry. A null page requires coordinate_system 'not_available' and a null bbox; it is never a substitute for an unextracted page.
